runtime.goThrough: PlayGoThroughAnimation sets countdown to _GoThroughDuration; speed scale evaluates _GoThroughCurve at 1-countdown/duration

notes: Original rent display is not a Spine character. Icon and Outline are real thick builtin cylinder meshes, rotated90deg aroundX.
Slot matrices are relative to NormalChessboard_01 and include Root45deg but exclude outer root scale.9, matching grid-hooks. At runtime use board center world position and identity token rotation.
Outline renderer has two material passes; second FriendHeadShadow is a projected shadow, not a second white body.
Do not add prefab root y.26: original runtime explicitly overwrites root world position with Center. Child Icon/Outline retain y.3.
